configuration.method: Rust CIXG1 automatic BEST; dynamically scheduled candidates with enforced soft time/memory policy
configuration.python_compatibility: frozen decoder supports PPM orders through 3

exposure: Existing verified Dickens only; no acquisition or new data search.
hypothesis: Searching Python-compatible PPM orders 1 and 2 in addition to order 3 can lower complete CIXG1 archive size on the same Dickens input; encode and decode remain exact.
longer_budget_justification: Input is the same 10.19 MB Dickens asset, below the 16 MiB moderate-contiguous cap. Existing dynamic BEST completes in about 331 seconds; the limited two-order PPM extension is budgeted at 600 seconds to allow a complete encode/decode and Python compatibility check, with no partial-size stopping.
matched_control: Frozen verified Dickens BEST CIXG1 v5: 3,506,980 bytes, SHA-256 4e02d23f43c48ef2812138a945d650bf9093b42e80cabfd8151258cbe23741d8; PPM order 3 selected for every block.
mechanism: For each shortlisted PPM block, materialize orders 3, 1 and 2, compare exact payload bytes under the same frame overhead, retain stable route-order tie behavior, then validate full Rust and Python decode.
promotion_criteria: Require a fully completed archive, exact fresh Rust decode, exact frozen Python decode, and record all size/time/memory/search counters. Promote order candidates only if complete archive shrinks or remains equal without unacceptable resource cost.
resource_accounting: WaveScheduler four distinct physical CPUs, 2 GB cgroup cap, 100 MB temp cap, 600 seconds encode+decode, no swap.
